descripcion_geo: Eastern Mediterranean island, identified with Minoan Crete. Land of origin of the Philistines according to the AT.
importancia_estrategica: Origin of the Philistines; The Caphtori displaced the Avei from the Canaanite coastal plain.

historias.descripcion: The OT states that the Philistines (Chereteites) came from Caphtor, identified with Crete; They arrived with the migration of the Sea Peoples.
The Caphtori came from Caphtor and destroyed the Avei who inhabited villages on the coastal strip of Gaza.

historias.titulo: Amos and the origin of the Philistines
historias.descripcion: The prophet Amos confirms that God brought Philistines from Caphtor, just as he brought Israel from Egypt.

personajes.descripcion: He cited the Philistine origin in Caphtor to demonstrate that God guides the movements of all peoples.
The Cherethites, related to the Philistines of Caphtor, were part of David's personal guard.
The people most mentioned as opponents of Israel in the OT came from Caphtor/Crete.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Caphtor (Crete): relevant geographical region in the Old Testament.

judaismo.descripcion: God brought out the Philistines from Caphtor just as he brought out Israel from Egypt (Am 9:7): all peoples are directed by divine providence.
judaismo.significado_teologico: God brought out the Philistines from Caphtor just as he brought out Israel from Egypt (Am 9:7): all peoples are directed by divine providence.
